progress.args.cardNeedsValue.text: --card needs a value: the card's key, as in --card HI-12 (an old --card "#1061" needs its quotes: a shell takes an unquoted # for the start of a comment).
progress.args.cardNeedsValue.note: #1219: cards are named by key; an unquoted #1061 in a shell is a comment, which leaves --card with no value.

progress.args.checkNoCommand.text: --check runs the project's command for {named, select, yes {{check}} other {the check}}: give no command of your own.
progress.args.checkNoCommand.note: #1220: a check's command is the project's. named: yes when the check has a name (check).

progress.args.focusedNeedsCommand.text: --check {check} runs the command you give after -- for that test.
progress.args.focusedNeedsCommand.note: HI-1367: a focused test's check (focused:<test>) runs a command of the caller's own. check: the check as given.

progress.args.isolatedNeedsCheck.text: --isolated runs a check in a copy of its own: use it with --check <name>.

progress.args.needsValue.note: option: title, revision or check, given last with no value.

progress.change.edit.note: What a write log's :edit mark records, in the list of what changed while a check ran.

progress.change.reflog.note: What a write log's :reflog mark records, in the list of what changed while a check ran.

progress.check.outsideHive.text: --check runs the project's command for {check}, which only Hive knows: run it in a session Hive started, with reporting on.

progress.check.waiting.note: #1435: no check copy is free. what: what it waits for, in Hive's words.

progress.isolated.notRun.note: #1435: the launcher wasn't put in its copy's job. why: Hive's reason, or the error.

progress.isolated.notRunStatus.text: the check wasn't run: Hive answered {status}
progress.isolated.notRunStatus.note: #1435: Hive answered with an error and no reason. status: its HTTP status.

progress.isolated.notRunUnreachable.text: the check wasn't run: Hive couldn't be reached ({detail})

progress.revision.form.text: revision is a commit (its id, or a name git knows)
progress.revision.form.note: Checked with git itself when Hive can't check it (reporting off, outside Hive), in the same words as Hive's refusal (check.link.revisionForm).

progress.revision.notACommit.note: named: the revision given; folder: where it runs.

progress.revision.notCheckedOut.text: {named} isn't what's checked out here ({head} is): check it out first, or leave --revision out
progress.revision.notCheckedOut.note: #1220: a run is checked against what is checked out where it runs. head: that commit, short.

progress.revision.nothingCheckedOut.text: Nothing is checked out in {folder} to compare {named} with (or git can't read it): leave --revision out
progress.revision.nothingCheckedOut.note: folder: where it runs; named: the revision given. A folder git cannot read refuses too: a revision that cannot be checked is not taken.

progress.run.commandNotFound.note: The command doesn't exist (ENOENT), as a shell says it; exit code 127.

progress.run.exitCode.note: A failed run's detail, stored with the run (the Default's words, whoever reads it).

progress.unanswered.answered.text: Hive couldn't be reached {lend, select, yes {to lend a check copy} other {to look up the command for {check}}} (Hive answered {status, select, none {with an error} other {{status}}}), so nothing was run.
progress.unanswered.answered.note: HI-1892: Hive answered with no link (an older Hive without the call, an error). status: its HTTP status, or none.

progress.unanswered.failed.text: Hive couldn't be reached {lend, select, yes {to lend a check copy} other {to look up the command for {check}}} ({detail}), so nothing was run.
progress.unanswered.failed.note: HI-1892: the call failed some other way. detail: the error's message.

progress.unanswered.refused.text: Hive couldn't be reached {lend, select, yes {to lend a check copy} other {to look up the command for {check}}} (connection {refused, select, yes {refused} other {not allowed: {detail}}} at {url}), so nothing was run. Is Hive running? A sandbox that blocks local network access (Claude Code's Bash sandbox does) stops it too: run the command outside the sandbox.
progress.unanswered.refused.note: HI-1892: nothing listens at Hive's address, or this process may not reach it. refused: yes for a refused connection, else detail is the error's code (EACCES, EPERM). url: Hive's address.

progress.unanswered.slow.text: Hive is slow to answer: no reply {lend, select, yes {to lend a check copy} other {to look up the command for {check}}} in {seconds} s{retried, select, yes {, asked {asked} times} other {}}, so nothing was run. Try again; Settings → Advanced → "hive-progress: Hive's reply time" gives it longer.
progress.unanswered.slow.note: HI-1892: Hive is there but busy. lend: yes for an isolated check's copy (#1435), else the check's command (check) was asked for. retried: yes when it was asked more than once (asked).

progress.uncounted.changed.text: not counted as check {check}: files changed in the folder while it ran{listed, select, yes { ({changes})} other {}}. Run it again with nothing else writing in the folder{isolate, select, yes {, or with --isolated (a check copy of its own)} other {}}.
progress.uncounted.changed.note: #1654. changes: what changed, joined with ", "; listed: yes when there are any. isolate: yes when --isolated (#1435) would help (a git project, not isolated already).

progress.uncounted.dirty.text: not counted as check {check}: the folder had uncommitted changes{listed, select, yes { ({changes})} other {}}. Commit or remove them, then run it again.
progress.uncounted.dirty.note: #1654. changes: what changed (paths, or progress.change.*), joined with ", "; listed: yes when there are any.

progress.uncounted.moved.text: not counted as check {check}: something else was checked out by the time it ended. Run it again.

progress.uncounted.notCheck.text: not counted as check {check}: Hive didn't see the check's configured command run. Run it again with hive-progress --check {check}.
progress.uncounted.notCheck.note: #1654: what happened, then what to do, so an agent is not left running the same command again for a submit that keeps refusing.

progress.uncounted.notContained.text: not counted as check {check}: what is checked out here doesn't contain the card's revision. Run it in the card's own folder, at its revision.

progress.uncounted.revisionChanged.text: not counted as check {check}: the card's declared files changed while it ran. Run it again.
progress.uncounted.revisionChanged.note: #1654: a card on the None platform (#1233).

progress.unrecorded.endedBefore.text: Hive recorded check {check}, but its reply was lost, so how it counted isn't known.
progress.unrecorded.endedBefore.note: HI-1892: a finish sent again found the first had arrived (its reply lost).

progress.unrecorded.noReply.text: Hive didn't confirm it recorded check {check} (no reply to its result, asked twice): if submitting says it hasn't passed, run it again.
progress.unrecorded.noReply.note: HI-1892: the run's finish got no reply, sent twice.

progress.unrecorded.noStart.text: Hive didn't take this run's report (no reply in time), so check {check} wasn't recorded: run it again.
progress.unrecorded.noStart.note: HI-1892: Hive never took the run's start.

progress.unrecorded.refused.text: Hive refused this run's result, so check {check} may not be recorded: run it again.
progress.unrecorded.refused.note: HI-1892: Hive answered the finish with an error.

progress.usage.text:
Usage: hive-progress [--title <title>] [--card <card>] [--revision <commit>] -- <command> [args...]
       hive-progress --check <name> [--isolated] [--title <title>] [--card <card>] [--revision <commit>]

Runs the command, passing its output through and returning its exit code, and shows it in Hive's Progress panel
with the time it usually takes, and the card and revision it ran for.
  --card <card>       the card it runs for ("#1061", quoted); without it, the card you are working on (yours in Doing)
  --revision <commit> the commit it runs on: it must be what is checked out here, or nothing runs; without it,
                      what is checked out when it starts
  --check <name>      runs the project's command for that check (the project's options name it), not one of yours;
                      focused:<test> (a card's focused test) runs your command after -- as that test's check
  --isolated          with --check: runs it in a check copy of its own at the card's revision, which nothing else
                      writes, so another agent's edits here can't spoil it (waits for a copy when none is free)
A line the command prints like
  ##hive-progress step=4 total=12 name=carddialog
says step 4 of 12 (carddialog) is starting, and isn't shown. The first total given is the run's: give it within the
first 2 seconds for a bar with steps from the start, or later for one from then on.
  ##hive-progress wait=a test slot (held by B4)
says the command waits (for a queue, a lock) and for what: no time left is shown meanwhile, and the wait doesn't count
against the usual time; "##hive-progress wait=" says it waits no more. A command interrupted by Ctrl+C shows as
stopped, and one whose hive-progress is killed as ended without a report. Outside Hive it just runs the command.
HIVE_PROGRESS=0 turns reporting off.
progress.usage.note: #1220 (--card, --revision, --check), #1435 (--isolated), HI-1367 (focused:<test>), #549 (wait=). Printed by --help and after a wrong option.
